artifacts.name: test_removed_test_function_kind_error_includes_targeted_hint
artifacts.source_scenario: A structurally valid manifest dict declares three removed_artifacts entries: kind test_function at index 0, a valid kind function at index 1, and kind test_function again at index 2.

expected.behavior: Both test_function entries produce errors that start with their unchanged 'removed_artifacts.<i>.kind:' enum message and contain the phrases 'test artifacts never need removed_artifacts entries' and 'superseding manifest'; the valid index-1 entry produces no error, proving the hint keys on the offending instance rather than a hardcoded index.

artifacts.name: test_removed_unknown_kind_error_has_no_test_hint
artifacts.source_scenario: The same manifest dict uses an unknown removed_artifacts kind such as 'component'.

expected.behavior: The enum error is returned unchanged with no appended hint text.

artifacts.name: test_valid_removed_artifact_kind_produces_no_error
artifacts.source_scenario: The manifest dict uses a valid removed_artifacts entry with kind: function.

expected.behavior: validate_manifest_schema returns no removed_artifacts errors, proving the hint path does not affect valid manifests.

artifacts.name: test_test_function_kind_elsewhere_gets_no_removed_hint
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest dict declares kind: test_function legitimately inside files.create artifacts while removed_artifacts is absent.

expected.behavior: No error and no hint is produced; the hint is scoped to the removed_artifacts path only.

artifacts.name: test_load_manifest_schema_error_carries_hint
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest file on disk contains a removed_artifacts entry with kind: test_function and is loaded through the public loader.

expected.behavior: load_manifest raises ManifestSchemaError whose message includes the appended hint, proving consumers inherit the enrichment without their own formatting.

artifacts.name: validate_manifest_schema
artifacts.description: Existing public schema validator; behavior extends so removed_artifacts kind enum failures with instance 'test_function' return the original 'path: message' string with an appended remediation hint.
